maria_cs: Heads-up: Lumina onboarding hit a burst of 429s during SDK init. They run an automated smoke that fires ~25 parallel session creates.
ben_engineer: Do we have their SDK logs? any pattern on timing?
maria_cs: They sent this sanitized snippet: 
```
POST /v1/sessions -> 200
send telemetry header: v=1;env=staging;session=xxxx
POST /v1/generate -> 429 (rate_limit)
```
maria_cs: It reliably shows up ~1s after session create when many inits are concurrent.
jess_sre: Sounds like a consistent-hash hotspot. If X-Client-Telemetry or similar got added to the hash key in some edge pools, parallel identical headers will map to one upstream.
ben_engineer: We recently rolled a config change to edge pools; possible drift added telemetry to hashing.
lucas_infra: Can you paste their request headers (sanitized) and tenant id?
maria_cs: Sample headers: 
```:method: POST
:user-agent: lumina-sdk/0.9.1
:content-type: application/json
:x-client-telemetry: v=1;env=staging;session=xxxx
:x-tenant-id: lumina-123
```
jess_sre: 25 parallel inits + same telemetry -> spike on a single shard -> per-upstream rate limiter fires 429s.
ben_engineer: Mitigation plan: (A) edge rule to ignore X-Client-Telemetry for traffic scoped to x-tenant-id: lumina-123 (tenant-scoped, temporary). (B) SDK patch 0.9.2 to stop sending the telemetry header on blocking init and instead background it with jitter.
lucas_infra: I can scope an edge exception and canary to 5% of lumina traffic first. I'll open PR and queue deploy.
maria_cs: Lumina wants a quick fix so they can proceed with onboarding. They're fine with a tenant-scoped canary.
jess_sre: Safety notes: limit rule to 48h max, add per-tenant queue-depth metric and alert, and roll back if we see increased cross-tenant imbalance.
ben_engineer: I'll prepare SDK patch and a short release note. ETA ~90m.
lucas_infra: PR created: PR-4912, canary deploy queued. deploy-bot: job queued for PR-4912.
maria_cs: Scheduling 20m call with Lumina in 30m to confirm throttle and canary. Will ask them to reduce parallel inits to <10 during the window.
jess_sre: Also adding a short-term server-side smoothing: if a tenant has a sudden init burst, apply internal backoff (soft) for 60s before hard 429 to reduce customer-visible errors. Low-risk change, will monitor.
ben_engineer: Action items recap: 1) lucas_infra: canary edge rule (PR-4912) -> 5% -> full if healthy. 2) ben_engineer: SDK 0.9.2 patch to background telemetry. 3) maria_cs: coordinate with Lumina and confirm post-canary logs.
deploy-bot: PR-4912 canary deploy started (canary=5%)
maria_cs: thanks team — I'll update after the call and paste any failing traces.
